evidence.title: Unstyled UI components for accessible design systems · Base UI

name: Base UI
summary: Unstyled, accessible React UI components from the creators of Radix, Floating UI and Material UI.
description: Base UI is a styling-agnostic React component library: 37 unstyled, composable components plus utilities, with no bundled CSS, so teams style them with Tailwind, CSS Modules, CSS-in-JS or plain CSS. Components follow WAI-ARIA patterns and WCAG 2.2, from accordion, dialog and combobox to menu, select, slider, tabs, toast and tooltip, and ship as @base-ui/react on npm for React 17+. MIT licensed and free for commercial use.
contains: components include accordion, autocomplete, combobox, dialog, drawer, menu, menubar, select, slider, tabs, toast
no bundled CSS; compatible with Tailwind, CSS Modules, CSS-in-JS and plain CSS
WAI-ARIA Authoring Practices patterns and WCAG 2.2 compliance
v1.0.0 released Dec 2025; release notes through v1.9.0 (Oct 2026)
